How to read this table

The lower end of each range is a headline rate reserved for the strongest applicants — a 750+ credit score, a salaried job at a category-A employer, a woman co-applicant, a low loan-to-value and a property in an approved project. Most people are quoted somewhere in the middle of the range.

These figures are indicative, sourced from lender disclosures as on August 2026, and change without notice. Nothing here is an offer. Ask us for a written quote before you decide.

Beyond the headline

Five things that matter as much as the rate

01

Your spread, not the benchmark

Floating rates are the repo rate plus a spread fixed for you at sanction. The benchmark is the same for everyone; the spread is what you actually negotiate, and it is what makes an old loan drift above the market.

02

Whether the lender funds your property

The cheapest lender is worthless if it will not fund a gram panchayat property, an unapproved deviation or a resale in an older building. Approved-project lists differ sharply between banks.

03

How the lender treats your income

Variable pay, rental income, cash salary and a second business are counted very differently. The same file can be worth ₹10–15 lakh more at one lender than another for this reason alone.

04

The total cost of fees

Processing fee, legal and technical charges, MODT stamp duty, documentation and any bundled insurance. On a ₹50 lakh loan the spread between a lean and a loaded fee structure is easily ₹40,000.

05

Service after disbursement

You will live with this lender for 20 years. How quickly they issue a provisional interest certificate, process a prepayment, or reset your spread on request matters far more than 5 basis points at sanction.

06

The insurance push

A rate quoted “subject to” a single-premium insurance policy funded into the loan is not really that rate. Ask for the rate without the policy and compare that number.

Important disclosure

JSR Home Loan Services is the loan facilitation arm of JSR Financial Associates. We work as a loan facilitator / Direct Selling Agent (DSA) for banks and housing finance companies. We are not a bank, an NBFC or a lender registered with the Reserve Bank of India. We do not lend money and we do not accept deposits.

Every application is assessed, sanctioned and disbursed solely by the partner bank or housing finance company, at its sole discretion and subject to its own credit policy; the loan agreement is between you and that lender. Interest rates, processing fees, eligibility figures and timelines shown on this website are indicative only, are taken from lender disclosures, change without notice, and vary with your credit profile, income and property. Calculator results are estimates for planning purposes and are not a sanction, an offer, or financial, tax or legal advice. Always confirm the final terms in the sanction letter issued by the lender before you commit.

Stay safe: we never ask for a fee in cash or to a personal account in exchange for a loan approval, and we will never ask for your OTP, net-banking password or card PIN.
